D/ FL IVL CONSTANS NOB CAES ; R/ GLORIA EXERCITVS

Pierced copper alloy Roman nummus of Constans as Caesar (333-337 AD), minted in Trier or Arles, 333-335 AD. Pierced at 2 o'clock. obv legend: FL IVL CONSTANS NOB CAES obv type: laureate head, draped and cuirassed facing right. rev legend: GLORIA EXERCITVS rev legend: two soldiers and two standards. Finder's number 12
